how_value_is_shown: A first-person voiceover states that the book is personal, the illustrations are accurate enough to recognise the child, and the name appears throughout; frames show the cover with the child's name, the interior spreads and a text page with the name. The likeness claim is stated in speech and cannot be verified from the frames, since the real child's face is not shown next to the cover.
demonstration: Unboxing the delivery, flipping through pages, a toddler holding, touching and hugging the book with an adult beside her
proof: Child using it (toddler handling the book, adult pointing at illustrations), the printed name visible on the cover and in the text page. No before/after or comparison.
emotion: Surprise and tenderness; caption: 'לא ציפיתי שזה ירגש אותי ככה…' and 'התגובה שלו? בכלל שברה אותי' (the toddler's reaction is promised in the caption)
personal_story: First-person: 'we received', 'when I opened it I was surprised by the level' (machine transcript); caption says she did not expect to be moved seeing the child inside a book. No longer story.
selling_language: 'זו כבר לא עוד מתנה, זו מזכרת אישית שנשארת לשנים' (machine transcript, also on screen); 'אם אתן מחפשות משהו באמת מיוחד לילדים שלכן' (on screen); 'מחכה לכן קופון בתיאור' (on screen); caption: '10% הנחה עם הקוד - Adib'
captions_on_screen: text boxes in an upper-middle position with a plain white font and dark outline, 3-4 lines, changing every few seconds in step with the speech (not word-by-word); a small white heart emoji at the end of the last caption
editing_rhythm: About 9 detected shots in 30 s (average about 3.3 s, ffmpeg cuts at 2.87, 4.63, 7.4, 10.7, 17.2, 21.1, 23.13, 25.9 s); alternates book close-ups with floor shots of the toddler; one cross-dissolve at about 9-10 s; no obvious speed changes
ending_and_cta: Last 3 s show the toddler holding the book on her lap, with on-screen text 'מחכה לכן קופון בתיאור' (speech: coupon in the description, machine transcript 'לחכה לכם קופון בתיאור'). The CTA is a coupon in the caption: '10% הנחה עם הקוד - Adib'.
price_or_code: '10% הנחה עם הקוד - Adib' (caption); no price shown
convincing: Interpretation: feels like a real mom's reaction; footage of an actual toddler on a rug with real clutter (ball, toys) looks homemade; showing the cover with the child's name, then inside pages including a text page with the name, makes the personalisation concrete; the emotional caption plus a small discount code is a simple, clear CTA.
weak_or_overproduced: Interpretation: the voiceover reads like a script (generic phrases such as 'מזכרת אישית שנשארת לשנים'); no spoken proof that the character looks like the child (the real child and cover character are never shown side by side); the caption promises the child's reaction which is only shown as handling the book; no disclosure wording despite a coupon code; 80 likes on 5,481 public plays.
lumebook_lesson: Interpretation: LumeBook's SMM can copy this with a phone and a child or friend's child: top-down shot of the cover on a blanket, then floor-level shots of a child with the book, flip pages in close-up, and show the name on the cover and in the text. To improve: show cover and child side by side, say one specific moment instead of generic praise, and state the offer in the video.
solo_without_child: partly: cover, page flips and the unboxing (about 50% of the footage) can be filmed alone; the floor shots with a toddler need a child
not_verified: Whether the on-screen coupon wording matches the speech exactly; whether the paid-partnership label was shown at posting (media_info shows 0); music presence (not clear, speech is voiceover over frames of hands and the toddler); the identity of the woman beside the toddler; machine transcript errors ('הייעורים', 'ביצור', 'מימי בוק', 'טבעוניים', 'לחכה').
